description: Assigns a conversation to a teammate, as the thread header's Assign menu does: assigned_member_id is the teammate's id (read entity org_members), or null to unassign; assigned_to (the teammate's exact name) is accepted instead. A name that is not exactly one current teammate is refused. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: assign_conversation
title: Assign a conversation
